title: Sam's Stickers
text:
Sam has sixty stickers. He has twenty red stickers and forty blue stickers. Sam likes his stickers very much.

His friend Mia has seventy stickers. She gives Sam ten stickers. Now Sam has seventy stickers too.

questions.text: How many blue stickers does Sam have?
How many stickers does Mia have?
How does Sam probably feel about his stickers?
options: He wants to throw them away.

questions.text: What kind of friend is Mia?

vocabulary.definition: small pieces of paper with a picture or design on one side
the colour of the sky on a sunny day
a person you know well and like spending time with

paragraph_translations: Sam'in altmış çıkartması var. Yirmi kırmızı çıkartması ve kırk mavi çıkartması var. Sam çıkartmalarını çok seviyor.
Arkadaşı Mia'nın yetmiş çıkartması var. Sam'e on çıkartma veriyor. Artık Sam'in de yetmiş çıkartması var.
